Cache.//Provider: Redis, or InMemory for a bench with no Redis on it. InMemory holds cart state, tag claims and hub tickets in this process only — cross-till tag arbitration is off, so two tills could sell the same tagged item. Refused outright in Production.

OpenIddict.//AllowInsecureHttp: Development only. Production must be HTTPS — an authorization code crossing a shop network in the clear is the whole attack.

Auth.//AdminPassword: Set these to create the first administrator. There is no default: a seeded credential is a published credential.
Auth.//CashierPassword: Same rule as the administrator: no default, so an unconfigured deployment gets no cashier.

SelfRegistration.//Enabled: Off by default. New accounts land on Role, whose sales commit nothing at all.

Demo.//SeedCatalogue: Writes ~136 invented products and their RFID tags. Never enable against a real shop's inventory.

Mail.//WriteToLog: Development only. With no relay configured, password-reset links are written to the log — which is a credential in a log, hence the explicit opt-in.
